text: The reporter saw stale-index warnings after compaction. Discussion identified false versus null: false == null is false, so the deletion branch was skipped. The author said the issue may have predated the compaction rewrite, and did not reproduce it locally. A separate concern about message-key assumptions was filed as bug 1899236. Current source has a later compaction pass architecture that checks database keys directly.
title: Bug 1898780 gloda compaction warning
